item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 15
item.description:
29 development commits

AI & NPC

  • Bandits have been upgraded to Generation 2 AI, improving their combat behavior and pathfinding.
  • A new caretaker NPC now patrols apartment complexes, knocking on rented rooms and using a peephole, adding an extra interactive element.

Raiding & Missions

  • The server now refuses to start a raid without a valid raid map, preventing crashes and showing a clear error instead of throwing.

Combat & Drones

  • Scout drones now emit flashing beeps, can fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and perform mid‑fight strikes, making them a more active threat.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Hold‑E missions now lock movement and camera, tie progress to the target, and reset if cancelled.
  • Ledger and maintenance‑log reads now take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after the read finishes.
  • Feedline repairs and pressure release can be performed using the existing pipe‑access pit and valve at Water Treatment.
  • Items stored in the safe‑pocket are now retained when the pocket loads before the saved backpack.
  • First loot item now appears during extraction and hotbar outlines are disabled.
  • Extraction missions have been refined and loot is now revealed before extraction.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 14
item.description:
25 development commits

Base & Economy

  • Stash upgrades now cost scrap (1,000 for the first row, doubling each additional row), stash limited to four extra rows, and scrap stacks increased to 2,000.
  • Outpost Supplies can now be both bought and sold from the same interface.
  • Loot items are priced by their actual value, furniture has its own contents, and blueprints now have weight, affecting inventory.

Combat & Weapons

  • Grenade controls and rocket launcher aiming have been refined for more reliable throws and targeting.
  • Third‑person players now see accurate bow arcs and improved aiming feedback.

NPC & Rewards

  • Each enemy type, including monument guards, now drops its own specific reward.

UI & Feedback

  • Hotbar now displays progress bars for timed actions, giving clearer feedback.
  • Binoculars and scopes are viewable in third‑person mode, improving scouting while staying behind cover.

Hub Features

  • Added a progress board, unlockable furnace, retained ovens, and a pay panel to the hub for expanded base management.

Combat & Mechanics

  • Third‑person attacks now align correctly, fixing hit registration issues.
